phase: Main-branch fix: SFC host powers the USB root port at 1150 ms uptime; build checks and physical validation with both controllers

change.summary: usb_host_install() with root_port_unpowered = CONFIG_FNK0099_SFC_ROOT_PORT_POWER_MS > 0; the usb_events task waits until that uptime, calls usb_host_lib_set_root_port_power(true) and logs 'root port power on: <err> uptime_ms=<n>', then runs the unchanged event loop
change.config: CONFIG_FNK0099_SFC_ROOT_PORT_POWER_MS, default 1150, range 0-5000, 0 = power at install as before; only for the SFC host image (depends on !FNK0099_HID_PROBE && !FNK0099_MSC_PROBE)
change.not_included: The recovery state machine of the prototype branch (it never acted once the first enumeration was delayed)

interpretation: The minimal main-branch change reproduces the prototype result: with the first root-port power-on at about 1.15 s, every attached start enumerated for both controllers (12/12 plus 3/3 physical RESET), and the first controller passed the stage 1-3 regression items on HID 1.1.0 (the right hold passed on the repeat). Host-first insertion after a boot without the SFC still works. The unplug-time EP command error line is reproducible with the keyboard open and has not been investigated. The minimum sufficient delay and the root cause of the ~0.6 s failure are not established; sample sizes are small.
